routes.switch_reconfigure: The first opportunity of each maximal same-label run is missed for reconfiguration; every later opportunity in that run yields one correct safe effect.
routes.two_step_cache: The first opportunity of the full sequence is a shared cold-start miss; within every run, opportunities after the first two are missed because the cached evidence expires after two opportunities.
routes.null_a: One correct safe effect at every opportunity, independent of order.
routes.null_b: One correct safe effect at every opportunity, independent of order.

schedule_rules.iid: Construct exactly 16 A and 16 B labels, then shuffle with Python random.Random(seed).
schedule_rules.clustered: Four runs of length 8, alternating labels; first label is A for even seeds and B for odd seeds.
schedule_rules.alternating: Alternate labels for all 32 opportunities; first label is A for even seeds and B for odd seeds.
schedule_rules.heldout_block: Two runs of length 16; first label is A for even seeds and B for odd seeds.

analysis.paired_delta: switch_reconfigure safe_effects minus two_step_cache safe_effects, paired by structure and seed.
analysis.pass_gate: On held-out seeds, at least one non-IID correlated structure has median paired delta >= +4 and at least one has median paired delta <= -4; null_a and null_b remain identical for every schedule; every route has zero forbidden effects and empty-release failures.
analysis.confidence: Finite deterministic fixture; no statistical confidence interval or real-workload inference.

limits: No model, provider, GUI, operating-system input, physical release, or real disturbance schedule.
No real-world prevalence, route efficacy, safety, human-tempo, or product claim.
